title: Historical Transitions Response
description: Historical order status transitions with metadata.

transitions.description: Ordered list of historical status transitions.

historicalTransition.title: Historical Transition
historicalTransition.description: A historical order status transition entry.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the status transition happened.

historicalTransitionsMetadata.title: Historical Transitions Metadata
historicalTransitionsMetadata.description: Metadata related to historical order status transitions.

version.description: Version of the transition history record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the transition history record was created.

modifiedAt.description: Timestamp when the transition history record was last modified.

orderStatus.description: Status of the order. Supported order statuses are `IN_CHECKOUT`, `CREATED`, `CONFIRMED`, `DECLINED`, `SHIPPED`, `COMPLETED`'. Customers can only change the order status from `CREATED` to `DECLINED`.
